messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — BrightMetrics showing a ~65% drop in token usage last 30d, renewal in 6 weeks. Main champion (Diane) left last week. They’re running a competitive PoC with Jetstream AI. We should triage risk and propose mitigation ASAP.
Owen (Solutions Eng): Ack. Do we have the usage breakdown (per-route + embedding vs gen)? Any error/latency spikes?
Maya (CSM): Pulling charts now. Quick snapshot: generation routes dropped most; embeddings steady. No big errors in the logs, but avg latency on gen up from 120ms -> 280ms around 2024-06-02.
Jules (Product): That latency bump coincides with the model rollout to v2-quant. Can you confirm which model variant BrightMetrics is pinned to?
Maya (CSM): They were on `redwood/galaxy-v1` then moved to `redwood/galaxy-v2-quant` on 2024-06-01 per rollout notes.
Owen (Solutions Eng): That explains it. Quant path can increase token-time for certain prompts. If embeddings steady, likely a perf/regression rather than usage intent change. We should repro with their prompt set. Can someone share a sample prompt?
Sam (AE): Contract end 2024-08-01. If they talk to Jetstream now we risk being outcompeted. I'll reach out to the exec sponsor (cc: Elena) and offer an enablement + exec review.
Elena (CS Ops): Recommend running the Renewal Risk playbook (step IDs below) and tagging this as "high" risk until follow-up. Quick checklist: 1) Audit perf by route, 2) Offer targeted enablement, 3) Propose short-term cost-free burst/dedicated capacity, 4) Capture competitor win criteria, 5) Book exec review.
Maya (CSM): Putting playbook steps into action. Booking a troubleshooting session with BrightMetrics ops tomorrow 09:30 PT. Sam — can you handle the exec outreach?
Sam (AE): Yep, I'll email the exec sponsor today and ask to include new stakeholder (product lead). Drafting now.
Owen (Solutions Eng): For the troubleshooting session, please run this quick repro to bring data:```bash
# quick usage queries
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/usage?customer=brightmetrics&range=30d&group_by=route" | jq .
# fetch recent deploys
curl -s "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deploys?customer=brightmetrics&limit=10" | jq .
```
Jules (Product): If repro confirms slowdown on v2-quant, we can temporarily pin them back to `galaxy-v1` or provide a perf-tuned quant config. I can prepare a small perf delta note for the exec brief.
Elena (CS Ops): Also capture their evaluation criteria for Jetstream: cost, latency, model parity, security. Ask Sales to get those on the record.
Maya (CSM): Noted. I'll ask for the PoC evaluation matrix in the call and capture any additional stakeholders.
Sam (AE): Suggest offering a 2-week Dedicated Burst (no charge) to demonstrate latency SLOs and reduce the perceived value gap. Thoughts?
Owen (Solutions Eng): Agree. Also propose a one-hour deep-dive with SRE + product to walk through perf tuning. That usually helps regain confidence.
Jules (Product): I'll join the deep-dive and bring the quant config changes.
Maya (CSM): Good. Immediate next steps: 1) repro + perf data (Owen), 2) exec outreach (Sam), 3) schedule enablement + deep-dive (Maya/Jules/Owen), 4) apply Renewal playbook tags & run risk survey (Elena). I'll update thread after tomorrow's ops call. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: New deploy detected for customer brightmetrics: `galaxy-v2-quant` rollout started 2024-06-01 14:05 UTC (rollout-id: r-9843).
Maya (CSM): Thanks — that deploy log confirms timing. Marking this high priority.
Elena (CS Ops): Logging this as `renewal_risk:high` and creating a follow-up task in Gainsight. I'll add the competitor flag `jetstream-poc`.
Sam (AE): I'll cc legal if we discuss any amendment for Dedicated Burst.
Maya (CSM): End plan — keep actions tight, try to get them back on `galaxy-v1` if perf repros, offer Dedicated Burst + executive review to neutralize Jetstream PoC. Will report after call.
